decision.explanation: Each of these values corresponds to the population of a distinct Licking Township according to the provided sources. '7,899' refers to Licking Township, Blackford County, Indiana (2010 census). '7,723' refers to Licking Township, Blackford County, Indiana (April 1, 2020 estimate). '3,870' refers to Licking Township, Licking County, Ohio (2000 census). '536' refers to Licking Township, Clarion County, Pennsylvania (2010 census). These are distinct geographic entities and thus their populations are separate and valid.
